name: eternal-mix
description: Awesome Mix: console-style YouTube Music, local music and Apple Music playback with fullscreen visuals for Decky Loader. Based on Now Playing by LoZazaMastro.
author: M2ljay

scripts.build: node scripts/validate-translations.mjs && tsc --noEmit --noUnusedLocals --noUnusedParameters && rollup -c && node scripts/strip-sourcemap.mjs
scripts.check:python: python -m py_compile main.py mix_backend.py mix_install_check.py mix_process_guard.py ytmusic_service.py mix_soundtrack.py runtime_compat.py legacy_migration.py mix_identity.py mix_update.py && python scripts/validate-frozen-runtime.py
scripts.verify: npm run check:i18n && npm run check:types && npm run check:python && npm run check:steam && npm test && node --check dist/index.js

contributors: Andrea Sgarro (LoZazaMastro), author of Now Playing
